title: More churchgoers say they sometimes doubt
subtitle: U.S. Protestant churchgoers, 2012, 2019 and 2025
caption: On all three measures, the share of churchgoers who admit doubt has risen since 2012. About a quarter now say so on each.
note: Item wording as summarized by Lifeway: during difficult circumstances they sometimes doubt God loves them and will provide; they typically doubt God is involved when things happen they can't explain; they sometimes doubt God can change the lives of non-Christians they know. Exact 2012 and 2019 wording is not printed on the release.

rows.label: Doubt God is involved in what they can't explain
